newsitem.title: UK: Astra says to launch six drugs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Astra says to launch six drugs in 1997.

text.p: Swedish drug company AB Astra said on Monday it plans to launch six products in 1997, the most ever in a one year period.
"We have never before had more launches in one year," Astra managing director Hakan Mogren said at a seminar.
Sales of local anesthetic and analgeic Naropin will exceed those of Xylocain within five to 10 years which is currently Astra's fifth largest product, Mogren said.
Astra also plans to launch its impotence agent Muse in Europe and the asthma drug Pulmicort turbuhaler in the U.S.
"All indications show (the Pulmicort turbuhaler) will be a huge success," said Mogren.

Astra also plans to launch the Oxis Tubuhaler, which is a fast working asthma medicine, hypertension treatment candesartan cilexetil (Atacand) and Colazide which can be used to treat acute ulcerative colitis.
In 1997 between 60,000 and 70,000 patients will be participating in Astra's clinical studies, the company said.
